glosses: to explode (to ruin or destroy a structure, idea, organization, etc. from the inside)

examples.text: Odrodzenie nurtów niepodległościowych ostatecznie rozsadziło imperium od środka, zgodnie zresztą z przewidywaniami Zbigniewa Brzezińskiego.
examples.translation: The rebirth of independence movements at last destroyed the empire from the inside – following Zbigniew Brzeziński's predictions.
examples.english: The rebirth of independence movements at last destroyed the empire from the inside – following Zbigniew Brzeziński's predictions.

examples.text: [...] pewność posiadania absolutnej, naukowej prawdy, która dominowała w nauce przez blisko dwa stulecia, na początku ubiegłego wieku zaczęła się walić, aż w końcu legła w gruzach. Powstanie mechaniki kwantowej i teorii względności rozsadziło świat naiwnego determinizmu i materializmu.
examples.translation: The certainty that one would have absolute, scientific truth, which was dominant in science for about two centuries, started to receive blows at the start of the previous century until it finally lay in ruins. The development of quantum mechanics and the theory of relativity exploded the world of naive determinism and materialism.
examples.english: The certainty that one would have absolute, scientific truth, which was dominant in science for about two centuries, started to receive blows at the start of the previous century until it finally lay in ruins. The development of quantum mechanics and the theory of relativity exploded the world of naive determinism and materialism.
